<function name="SetCorner" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the position of a corner of a nav area.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="corner" type="number">The corner to set, uses <page>Enums/NavCorner</page></arg>
		<arg name="position" type="Vector">The new position to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
